periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible left eye patch is oriented at approximately a 45-degree downward angle relative to the horizontal midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval morphology with a vertical elongation; the height-to-width ratio is approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with a teardrop effect, where the lower terminal point is significantly further from the centroid than the upper margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve on the posterior edge with no sharp angular vertex.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is moderately wide, representing approximately 30% of the visible torso length along the dorsal-ventral axis.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the two ear regions is distinct and roughly equal to the width of one pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular and smooth apex curvature with no visible flattening of the top edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong yellowish-tan tinting present on the dorsal and flank fur, contrasting with the whiter cranial fur.
